source: To let all forecast users adjust their own forecast amounts, under Enable Forecast Adjustments, select <uicontrol>Enable owner adjustments</uicontrol>.
reference: 要让所有预测用户在“启用预测调整”调整其预测金额,请选择<uicontrol>启用所有人调整</uicontrol>。

source: <codeph>UPDATE VIEWSTAT</codeph> clause
reference: <codeph>UPDATE VIEWSTAT</codeph> 子句

source: In the Test Data Size section, click the lookup icon next to the <parmname>Select a user</parmname> field to choose the user you want to test. While users must be mobile-enabled in order to assign them to mobile configurations, you can test the configuration's data size against any user account.
reference: 在“测试数据大小”部分中,单击<parmname>选择用户</parmname>字段旁边的查找图标,以选择要测试的用户。虽然用户必须支持移动才能向其分配移动配置,但您可以针对任何用户客户测试配置的数据大小。

source: To direct your users to a specific Salesforce authorization endpoint, specify a URL with the <parmname>provAuthorizeEndpointHost</parmname> request parameter and a valid https host. Query strings appended to the host URL are ignored. However, you can specify a community path.
reference: 要将您的用户定向到特定 Salesforce 授权端点,请指定具有 <parmname>provAuthorizeEndpointHost</parmname> 请求参数的 URL 和有效的 https 主机。附加到主机 URL 的查询字符串已忽略。但您可指定社区路径。

source: Usage is calculated in characters. You can store up to 10 million characters.
reference: 使用情况使用字符计算。您最多可以存储 1000 万个字符。

source: In <ph>Lightning Experience</ph>, the Entitlements related list isn’t available on Contacts.
reference: 在 <ph>Lightning Experience</ph> 中,权利相关列表在联系人中不可用。

source: Review examples of validation rules for various types of apps that you can use and modify for your own purposes. <term>Validation rules</term> verify that the data a user enters in a record meets the standards you specify before the user can save the record.
reference: 出于自己的目的,请查看您可以使用和修改的多种类型应用程序的验证规则示例。用户保存记录之前,<term>验证规则</term>会验证用户在记录中输入的数据是否符合您指定的标准。

source: If your organization uses Live Agent to manage chats, you can either use the Live Agent widget or the Omni-Channel widget to manage chats, but not both. To learn more about managing Live Agent, see <xref>Use Omni-Channel with Your Existing Live Agent Implementation</xref>.
reference: 如果您的组织使用 Live Agent 管理图表,您可以使用 Live Agent 小部件或全渠道小部件管理图表,但不是使用二者同时管理。有关管理 Live Agent 的更多信息,请参阅<xref>通过现有 Live Agent 实施使用全渠道</xref>。
